description: Tasks template for upgrading to latest LTS versions

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 21, update build configuration files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 21, ensure compatibility with Java 21 language features and APIs
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded Java from version 1.8 to version 21. Updated maven.compiler.source and maven.compiler.target to 21 in both demo/pom.xml and democlient/pom.xml. Updated maven-compiler-plugin to 3.11.0 and maven-surefire-plugin to 3.0.0. All builds and unit tests pass successfully.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 (Latest LTS)
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace, update dependencies to compatible versions, address breaking changes in Spring Boot 3.x configuration and APIs
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded Spring Boot to version 3.4.1. Converted both projects to Spring Boot applications. Migrated javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace. Updated Spring Framework to 6.2.1. Modernized RabbitMQ consumer with Spring AMQP annotations. All builds and unit tests pass successfully.

tasks.description: Update project dependencies to compatible versions
tasks.requirements: Update all project dependencies to versions compatible with Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4, resolve version conflicts, update deprecated APIs, ensure all third-party libraries are compatible with the new versions
